basic_details.short_information: Defence Research and Development Establishment (DRDE) has announced 8 temporary vacancies for Paid Intern posts across Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, and Engineering. The internship tenure is for a minimum period of 06 months, with a monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000 for all posts. Eligibility criteria vary according to the specific post qualifications detailed in the notification. Interested candidates can apply by submitting the duly filled application form along with required documents by speed post or by email on or before 14 November 2026. how_to_apply: Candidates must prepare their application in the prescribed format (Annexure - 'A') and submit it along with all required supporting documents either by speed post or via email latest by 14 November 2026.
By Speed Post: Send the application and documents to: Director, DRDE, DRDO, Ministry of Defence, Jhansi Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, Pin Code-474002.
By Email: Email the documents to [email protected] and [email protected].
Documents named in the notice to be submitted with the application:
Duly Filled Application Form (Annexure - 'A') with recent passport size photograph affixed and self-attested
Recent referral/sponsorship letter from the respective college/university (format given in notification)
Self-attested copies of all degrees/academic qualification certificates/mark sheets/experience certificates
Copy of Aadhar Card & PAN Card
Signed undertakings for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and IT Rules and Regulations applicable for Ministry of Defence
For inquiries, candidates may contact DRDE at Phone No.: 0751-2390120, 2390122 or visit the official website at www.drdo.gov.in.
important_instructions: Electronic items including smartphones, mobile phones, pen drives, laptops, CD-ROMs, and any type of electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited inside the DRDE Gwalior Campus. Attendance must be marked by the interns as per Lab/Establishment procedures or Biometric/Aadhar based systems. Working hours and gazetted/closed holidays will be as applicable to the DRDE Lab/Establishment. No leave except sick leave (with production of a valid medical prescription) will be granted. Interns must submit a progress report after 03 months and a final project report after 06 months/completion of the course. A Completion Certificate will be issued only after successful completion of the 06-month project and submission of the project report. Original referral/sponsorship letters, qualification certificates, experience, age proof, ID, and address proofs must be produced for verification at the time of reporting. Incomplete or erroneous applications or those received after the due date will be rejected. The decision of Director DRDE Gwalior will be final in case of any discrepancy. No further communication in this regard will be entertained.

rows.details: Defence Research and Development Establishment (DRDE), DRDO
Paid Intern (Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Engineering)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: DRDE has announced a total of 8 vacancies under the Paid Internship Scheme. Vacancies are tentative and may change as per organizational requirement; unfilled vacancies may be merged with other subjects.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens pursuing Graduate or Post Graduate courses and must have a good academic record with 75% & above marks (or ≥ 7.5 CGPA) from AICTE/UGC approved Colleges/Universities. Candidates must also possess a recent referral/sponsorship letter from their respective college or university. The age limit is Below 28 Years as on 14th Nov, 2026.

rows.essential_qualification: Pursuing M.Sc. or equivalent (03rd/04th Sem) or B.Tech (07th/08th Sem) in Biological Sciences (Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Pharmacology/ Toxicology/ Immunology)
Pursuing M.Sc. or equivalent (03rd/04th Sem) in Chemistry (Organic Chemistry/ Inorganic Chemistry/ Analytical Chemistry)
Pursuing B.E./ B.Tech. (07th/ 08th Sem) in Electronics/ Mechanical Engineering/ Information Technology/ Computer Sciences

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The internship will run for a minimum duration of 06 months, starting from 01st January, 2027 onwards. A fixed stipend of Rs. 5,000/- per month will be paid for the entire duration in two equal installments: Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 03 months, and Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 06 months of internship. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. Accommodation is not provided by DRDO/DRDE. No TA/DA will be paid for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must prepare their application in the prescribed format (Annexure - 'A') and submit it along with all required supporting documents either by speed post or via email latest by 14 November 2026. By Speed Post: Send the application and documents to: Director, DRDE, DRDO, Ministry of Defence, Jhansi Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, Pin Code-474002. By Email: Email the documents to [email protected] and [email protected] . Documents named in the notice to be submitted with the application: Duly Filled Application Form (Annexure - 'A') with recent passport size photograph affixed and self-attested Recent referral/sponsorship letter from the respective college/university (format given in notification) Detailed resume Self-attested copies of all degrees/academic qualification certificates/mark sheets/experience certificates Copy of Aadhar Card & PAN Card Bank Details Signed undertakings for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and IT Rules and Regulations applicable for Ministry of Defence For inquiries, candidates may contact DRDE at Phone No.: 0751-2390120, 2390122 or visit the official website at www.drdo.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on educational qualifications and on fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria (minimum 75% marks or ≥ 7.5 CGPA). Mere applying with required documents or fulfilling the required criteria will not ascertain candidature/paid internship. If required, an interaction will be conducted through telephonic mode or Video Conferencing (VC). Only shortlisted candidates will be informed for the interaction or offer of internship, and they must report to the Lab/Establishment as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the internship offer letter. Final selection does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO.

A Completion Certificate will be issued only after successful completion of the 06-month project and submission of the project report. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies in total: 3 for Biological Sciences, 3 for Chemical Sciences, and 2 for Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DRDE Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications by speed post or email is 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the internship?
faq.answer: Applicants must be pursuing M.Sc. (3rd/4th Sem) or B.E./B.Tech (7th/8th Sem) in relevant disciplines with at least 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DRDE Paid Interns?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 28 years of age as on 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What stipend is paid during the DRDE internship?
faq.answer: Interns receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000/-, paid in two equal installments of Rs. 15,000/- after 3 months and 6 months.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for DRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their completed application form (Annexure - 'A') with required enclosures via speed post to DRDE Gwalior or by email to [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DRDE Paid Interns?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting according to academic qualifications, followed by telephonic or video conferencing interaction if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is accommodation or boarding provided during the internship?
faq.answer: No, DRDO/DRDE does not provide accommodation, boarding, or lodging expenses during the internship tenure.

faq.question: Q10. Does this internship lead to permanent employment in DRDO?
faq.answer: No, the offer of award of Paid Intern does not confer any right for absorption or regular appointment in DRDO.
